description: Connected Services data-product catalog. Config-seeded and Lambda-bundled rather than a DynamoDB table (spec 2026-09-10-cms-connected-services-subscriptions D3), versioned like services/data_processing/manifests/oem1-transform.json. Group 1 seeds the telemetry product; diagnostics added by T4.1; charging-sessions-v1 fully landed by T4.2d (10 seeded rows in cms-{stage}-storage-charging-sessions).

products.name: Charging Sessions
products.description: EV charging session records including session start/end times, energy delivered, and charging station. Backed by cms-{stage}-storage-charging-sessions (10 seeded rows on staging as of T4.2d). Sort key uses ISO-8601 sessionStartTime.
